news.title: SLU Launches Next-Generation Geospatial Center to Power Innovation in St. Louis and Beyond
news.summary_en: Saint Louis University has launched a new center focused on advancing geospatial research, fostering collaboration and developing solutions that benefit communities here at home and around the world.
